component.name: Corbomite
component.summary: Knowledge manager built around a local folder of Markdown notes

description.p: Corbomite is a note-taking and knowledge-management application for people who keep their notes as plain Markdown files in a folder they own. Your vault is an ordinary directory of .md files: readable without Corbomite, editable with any other tool, and yours to move between applications at any time.

ul.li: Three editor modes — live preview, raw Markdown source, and a styled reading view
Wiki-link and Markdown-link navigation with automatic link rewriting on rename
Backlinks, outgoing links, an outline, and a full-text search panel with regex and match-case toggles
Bases — query your notes as a table with a filter builder and formula columns
Canvas — arrange notes and media on an infinite board with connections
A local and global graph view, a command palette, and a quick switcher
Live word count, templates, and daily notes
A plugin API, with example plugins in the source tree

description.p: Corbomite reads and writes the same .obsidian configuration that Obsidian uses, so a vault can be shared between the two without conversion. Files are always stored as UTF-8 Markdown, and saves go through an atomic write so an interrupted save cannot truncate a note.
Context-sensitive menus and toolbars that adapt to the focused tab's document type (Markdown, canvas, bases, graph), including a canvas menu with snap, grid, and zoom controls.
Rich clipboard support: multi-flavour Copy, Copy as, and smart paste that converts HTML and RTF to Markdown.
Canvas authoring parity — node and edge creation, snapping, and selection polish.
First public release. Markdown editing with live preview, source and reading modes, link navigation, search, backlinks, bases, canvas, graph views, and a plugin API.
